data.name: No known Chat field is intentionally dropped on this route. Unknown/Chat-only fields prefer a Chat Completions backend, with semantic translation as fallback when no matching backend is available. Valid JSON may be reserialized.

data.name: Ollama input or legacy prompt becomes OpenAI input; OpenAI data[].embedding is reconstructed as Ollama embeddings[].
